correctness.rationale: In a cubic graph, complementing a perfect matching gives a spanning 2-factor, Hamiltonian precisely when connected; complement preserves symmetric difference. The incidence graph has girth 8: no 4-cycles from unique syntheme containment and no 6-cycles because three pairwise disjoint duads form a unique syntheme. Independently implemented canonical least-unmatched-vertex perfect-matching recursion from duad/syntheme incidence, exhaustively yielding 288 distinct matchings: 144 Hamiltonian complement and 144 disconnected (10,20) complement. All 144 choose 2=10,296 distinct Hamiltonian-pair differences were tested. Exactly 504 are size 10 and each is a single alternating 10-cycle; none has difference <10. All 144 trade degrees equal 7 and BFS from every state gives histogram (1,7,36,85,15). Exhaustion is mathematically valid for this explicitly finite 30-vertex graph because every perfect matching is uniquely generated by choosing the partner of its least unmatched vertex; it is not a sample. The frozen package also contains an independent anchored Hamiltonian-path DFS validator, structurally distinct from matching enumeration; checked its source and boundary conditions.
